A_to_G.A: Retain existing60/40/80m2 authority; clarify area reference before deriving net needs
A_to_G.B: Minimum short side is derived from an approved functional arrangement, not a default scalar
A_to_G.C: Minimum local depth depends on chosen arrangement/orientation and actual envelopes
A_to_G.D: Recommended aspect range UNAVAILABLE pending comparable positive functional cases
A_to_G.F: Evidence-backed long line or irregular-site solutions remain admissible; no beauty-only gate
A_to_G.G: Missing inputs return OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED; source unverified returns UNVERIFIED; no PASS

changing_room.front_service_zone: Project envelope for door movement, changing users and any approved sharing. Never use max() to assume simultaneous overlap safe. Peak shift, stored-clothes users and simultaneous users are different inputs.

coating_room.condition: All sets project-bound in a common local frame; absence is not an empty envelope. Assess both states; overlap/shutdown assumptions need explicit approval.

hypothetical_screening_counts.scope: Only two Changing rooms under the explicitly unselected S06 scenario; not project rejection or calibration

office.conditions: Separate non-overlapping user/passage lanes assumed; different actual furniture layouts need their own envelope, not this module as a universal hard bound
office.formula: W_clear >= rows*(desk_depth + user_zone) + independent_aisle + side_storage; L_clear >= ceil(N_staff/rows)*desk_width +2*end_space
